observations.text: Coating Technical File remarks not accepted; coating on plates renewed during dry dock was said to be done by ship staff
Short term SEQ certificate issued due to fire door damage not reflected; certificate uploaded still showed full term
Rest hours non-conformities: office response acknowledged by Marine Superintendent instead of Vessel Manager as required by monitoring messages
Working at height definition in SMS did not match COSWP; specific valve of 1.8 m mentioned
Incident risk ratings given as Medium not accepted; inspector wanted High risk
Bridge windows anti-piracy bullet proof shatter film not fully transparent
Emergency room blower mist catcher vanes supports loose
Midship port side draft gauge remove valve stand thinned down considerably
Synthetic ropes used in drums designed for wires at forward station
Three foam monitors could not be held vertical due to worn locking pin and plate
Responsible person did not keep items in good condition
GA plan did not incorporate BWTS room on main deck
Annual pressure test certificate did not separately mention reducers, U pieces and Y pieces tested

positives: Bridge overall inspection was satisfactory and received a positive observation
style: Strict on documentation and does not accept ship staff remarks without office evidence
Repeatedly mentions the gangway ID and baggage check incident throughout the inspection
Checks PIQ dates and requires exact wording from company procedures
Detailed questioning of junior officers on IG system and enclosed space entry
Prints report on board with MOPRIA compliant printer and does not change findings after discussion

questions.q: Are all defects in this list? If any defect is observed that is not in the list, it will get an observation.
Show the UMS procedures in the SMS.
What action was taken on the HHC critical alert in the lube oil analysis report, and is it entered in the PMS defect list?
Does the man overboard drill record mention recovery of persons from the water?
Are there any non-conformities in the rest hours records?
What office action was taken to mitigate the rest hour non-conformities?
What is the company definition of accident, incident and near miss in the SMS?
What are the company procedures for working at heights?
What are the characteristics of an isolated danger buoy and a safe water mark?
What are the enclosed space entry and safety measures?
What are your rank job duties and prospects as per SMS?
What is the secondary means of venting?
Explain the inert gas system in detail.

Company procedures for working at heights and PTW
Company definitions of accident, incident and near miss
Last incident reports and risk ratings
Passage plan, UKC performa and squat calculations
Bridge and engine room manning levels
Safety settings in ECDIS
Compass error log and sextant usage
Tidal information
Fire isolation check in bridge checklist
RADAR operation and performance
NAVTEX stations
Bridge windows anti-piracy shatter film transparency
Lifeboat tried out ahead and astern and rudder operation
Emergency room blower mist catcher vanes supports
Emergency generator and rescue boat engine operation
Midship port side draft gauge remove valve stand
Synthetic ropes in drums designed for wires
Three foam monitors locking pin and plate
GA plan incorporation of BWTS room
Enclosed space permits in ballast tanks and chlorine tubes inventory

All possible alarms tried out

tips: Ensure all defects are entered in the PMS defect list before the inspection
Keep short term certificates and their status clearly documented
Make sure rest hour non-conformity responses are acknowledged by the correct office role
Use exact COSWP wording for working at height definitions
Check that incident risk ratings match company and inspector expectations
Verify HVPQ is updated with all incidents
Maintain bridge window films for full transparency
Secure all loose supports on engine room blower mist catchers
Replace worn locking pins and plates on foam monitors
Update GA plans to include all new spaces such as BWTS room
Ensure pressure test certificates separately list reducers, U pieces and Y pieces
summary: Inspector Capt. Bogdan Sandrea boarded in Antwerp on 15 Dec 2024 and conducted a thorough SIRE inspection with 14 observations. He was strict on documentation, rest hours, working at height definitions, incident risk ratings and HVPQ accuracy, and repeatedly mentioned a gangway ID and baggage check incident. The bridge inspection was positive overall, but numerous hardware and process findings were raised on deck, in the engine room and in the CCR.
